programForm.description: Explicit programme form. It selects the P0/P1 author modules and must not be inferred from the topic or planning basis.

explainerType.description: Optional explicit user choice within historical-explainer. P0 preserves it; when absent P0 determines the type from the current request and materials.

planningBasis.description: Initial user-supplied material, independent of research tools. All historical-explainer requests search for existing programmes first, prefer video-based synthesis with supporting literature, and use literature-led creation only when no suitable programme is found. topic-led may acquire videos during P0; book-led supplies a book without selecting a separate explainer workflow; video-led supplies a prepared local manifest whose video identities are retained when merging. Documentary planning-basis rules are unchanged.

audience.description: Optional starting audience hypothesis. P0 determines the final audience within the authorized request.

episodeCount.description: Optional starting preference. P0 decides the final count from the authorized request unless constraints explicitly fix it.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Optional programme-wide planning ceiling for every episode, requested by the user or platform. It is not a P1 acceptance limit.

visualPackage.description: Optional user preference for P0 to consider. P0 makes the final selection; downstream reads only program.yaml.

coverPackage.description: Optional user preference for P0 to consider. P0 makes the final cover selection; downstream reads only program.yaml.

openerTemplate.description: Optional initial opener choice. When absent P0 selects opposed-opener; downstream reads only program.yaml.

researchLibrary.description: Optional existing NotebookLM library. P0 compares its sources with the programme-wide material needs, acquires only genuine gaps within the authorized request, and reuses this single library instead of creating another one.
